subtheme: 1: missing essential parameter in a service request
mode: single (all), two-way ASK/ANSWER format block used verbatim from tasks/ambiguity/spec.md

balance.order: shuffled with a fixed seed; not alternating (S=ASK, N=ANSWER): SSNNNNNSSNSNSSSSNNNSN

verification: Every expected ANSWER value (28, 15:45, Thursday, 60, 7, 55, 30, 42, 12:25, Monday, plus a direct lookup Friday) was computed by Python code in the generator script (integer arithmetic, datetime for times, weekday list walk for days), not by mental arithmetic.

Beyond the required reference/negative pair, each task was self-tested with lab.core.run_check: 2-3 alternative correct wordings must pass (ASK tasks: other phrasings naming the missing item; ANSWER tasks: answer with trailing period) and 3-5 wrong replies must fail (ASK tasks: questions about a fact printed in the prompt, a restatement of the task, and ask-plus-answer replies; ANSWER tasks: plausible wrong numbers, days or times). All self-tests passed.
All prompts are under 700 characters; all content is fictional businesses.
model_runs: none (held-out tasks; no pilot was run)
notes: The file has 21 tasks, so the ASK/ANSWER split is 10/11 rather than exactly half.
Each task carries tags.expected (ASK or ANSWER) as free metadata for later analysis.
Other generators' files were not read; nothing under lab/ or artifacts/ was modified; git was not used.
